title: Abnormality Notes
description:
When an abnormality has 3 or more research, notes are downloaded into your field guide that contain useful containment information, such as preferred work types.

This is located in the book button of your inventory or the pause menu.

Tool abnormalities work a little differently, unlocking entries whenever the worst outcome possible with it is triggered. If you don't know what a tool abnormality is doing, read its notes.
